title: Bur Oak (7166786338)
author: Loozrboy from Toronto, Canada
description: Cornell's other (and notwithstanding Cornell Park Ave.'s aspirations, real) main street is Bur Oak Ave., which runs a considarable distance through several other Markham neighbourhoods. Unlike most Markham thoughfares, it's lined for its entire length with homes, businesses, and services, rather than parking lots and backyard fences.

title: Fireworks stand in Cedar Mill, Oregon, supporting Sunset HS
author: Steve Morgan
description: A small fireworks stand in Cedar Mill, Oregon , with proceeds going to support the marching band and color guard of nearby Sunset High School (of the Beaverton School District). This stand was located in the parking lot of the Bales Thriftway store, near the intersection of Saltzman & Cornell Roads.

title: Cornell Tech td (2019-11-03) 022
author: Tdorante10
description: A Parkeon Muni Meter on East Loop Road at the north end (Phase 1) of the Cornell Tech campus, at East Loop Road and North Loop Road at approximately Manhattan 58th Street in the southern half of Roosevelt Island, Manhattan. This meter may be exclusively for Cornell students and/or for credit cards, as the coin and bill slots appear to be covered up.

title: Students walking and crossing streets with clock tower in distance at Cornell University
author: Tomwsulcer
description: The Cornell campus is on a hill. There is little parking so most students walk or take buses to class. A photo from a campus visit to Cornell on April 9, 2012 (actual date of photo).
